indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_runs_claimed_unique ON public.agent_runs USING btree (task_id) WHERE ((orchestration_state)::text = 'claimed'::text)

CREATE INDEX agent_runs_dispatch_poll ON public.agent_runs USING btree (org_id, orchestration_state, next_retry_at) WHERE ((orchestration_state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['unclaimed'::character varying, 'retry_queued'::character varying])::text[]))
CREATE INDEX agent_runs_stall_scan ON public.agent_runs USING btree (org_id, orchestration_state, started_at) WHERE ((orchestration_state)::text = 'running'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX docs_org_external_id ON public.documents USING btree (org_id, external_id) WHERE (external_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX tasks_dispatch_eligible ON public.tasks USING btree (org_id, status, priority, created_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'ready'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_wf_def_org_project_name_unique ON public.workflow_definitions USING btree (org_id, COALESCE(project_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), name)
